location.icb: NHS Greater Manchester Integrated Care Board

waitingTimes.description: Across Greater Manchester, most patients booking a routine GP appointment are seen within two weeks. Same-day urgent slots are usually available; walk-in services are available at most community pharmacies for free blood-pressure checks.
waitingTimes.disclaimer: This is an area-level signal, not a personal prediction. Your own wait will depend on your GP practice, your reason for booking, and the time of year.

officialContent.title: NHS Health Check
officialContent.summary: A free check-up of your overall health for adults aged 40-74 in England who don't already have certain long-term conditions. It checks your circulation and heart health, and is normally offered every five years.

officialContent.title: Free pharmacy blood pressure check
officialContent.summary: If you're 40 or over and live in England, you can get your blood pressure checked for free at most community pharmacies. No appointment is needed and you don't need to be registered with that pharmacy.

officialContent.title: High cholesterol
officialContent.summary: Cholesterol is a fatty substance found in your blood. Too much of it can raise your risk of heart and circulation problems over time. A simple blood test from a GP or pharmacy tells you your numbers.

officialContent.title: High blood pressure
officialContent.summary: High blood pressure rarely has symptoms, so the only way to know if you have it is to get it checked. NHS pharmacies offer free walk-in checks to anyone aged 40 or over in England.

officialContent.title: Stop smoking
officialContent.summary: Free support to stop smoking is available across the NHS, including local stop-smoking services, your GP, and pharmacies. Combining specialist support with stop-smoking aids gives you the best chance of quitting for good.

officialContent.title: Healthy weight
officialContent.summary: Keeping to a healthy weight reduces your risk of heart disease and many other long-term conditions. The NHS has free tools for working out your BMI and small everyday changes that add up.

population.notes: Illustrative context for the renderer: Manchester is an urban authority with a younger-than-average population and pockets of higher health inequality. Specific numbers are not asserted by this file — the renderer is contractually barred from inventing percentages.
